newsitem.title: USA: Saliva holders OK increase in capital.
newsitem.headline: Saliva holders OK increase in capital.

text.p: Saliva Diagnostic Systems Inc Thursday said shareholders approved an increase in the company's authorized capital.
This approval authorizes an increase in the company's common stock to 33 million shares from 25 million shares.

"This important step enables the company to move forward with its plans to obtain necessary financing for immediate manufacturing, regulatory approvals, R&D, and working capital needs," said Ken McLachlan, president and chief executive officer of Saliva Diagnostic Systems. "It also reinforces the company's drive for sales of its products into foreign markets, enhanced by its recently announced relationship with BioChem ImmunoSystems Inc, a division of BioChem Pharma Inc.
